name: Healthcare AI evaluations
icp_description: We sell Managed Healthcare AI Evaluations: we design tests, run weekly evals, analyze failures, and recommend prompt, model and cost fixes for clinical AI agents. Plans run $499-$4,999+/mo and the cold CTA is a free 30-minute evaluation gap assessment. Our buyers are product-led healthcare software and AI companies, Seed to Series C, US-primary, shipping agents for clinical documentation, patient communication, or intake and triage. The buyer is a Founder/CEO, CTO/VP Engineering, Head of AI/ML or Head of Product who owns agent reliability; Compliance or AI Governance often co-signs. Prior-authorization and coding workflows are expansion, not the wedge. We do not sell to hospitals or health systems as the direct buyer, to non-healthcare AI companies, to hyperscalers or EHR incumbents, or to peer AI eval and safety vendors. Entry work uses mock or development data only, never PHI.

criteria.name: Target clinical workflow
criteria.description: The company ships or is building an AI agent for clinical documentation, patient communication, or intake and triage. Revenue-cycle, prior-authorization, coding, credentialing or dental-only products count only as adjacent, not as the core wedge.

criteria.name: Decision-maker named
criteria.description: A Founder, CEO, CTO, VP Engineering, Head of AI/ML or Head of Product is identified by name or title. A junior, business development, marketing or unnamed company inbox contact does not satisfy this.

criteria.name: Agent in production or expanding
criteria.description: Explicit evidence the AI agent is live with real clinics or users, or is actively being expanded, rather than an idea, a pilot with no users, or general AI interest.

criteria.name: Product-led company, not hospital IT
criteria.description: A healthcare software or AI product company between Seed and Series C. Hospitals, health systems, hyperscalers, EHR incumbents and peer AI evaluation vendors do not satisfy this.

criteria.name: Reliability or compliance trigger
criteria.description: A named eval, quality or compliance pressure: a health-system vendor review or security questionnaire, a recent model or prompt change, quiet failures, missed escalations, wrong fields, denials, or rising support load.

criteria.name: US go-to-market
criteria.description: The company sells into US clinics or providers. A non-US headquarters is fine when US customers are evident; no US go-to-market does not satisfy this.

criteria.name: No mature in-house eval function
criteria.description: No established internal clinical-agent evaluation team. Hiring for evals, or having a single engineer on it, still satisfies this; a staffed eval or model-quality org does not.

industry_levels: Out of scope: non-healthcare, or the primary buyer is a hospital or health system, a hyperscaler, an EHR incumbent, or a competing AI evaluation vendor
Adjacent healthcare: revenue cycle, prior authorization, coding, credentialing, dental-only, or payer-facing dialers
Healthcare AI sold to clinics, but outside the wedge workflows
Core target: healthcare AI for clinical documentation, patient communication, or intake and triage, sold primarily to clinics and practices
Core target and EHR-adjacent at scale, serving multiple clinic groups
maturity_levels: Stage unclear from the available evidence
Series A to B, shipping to paying clinics
Late Series B to C, multiple clinic groups and formal vendor reviews
intent_levels: No stated need, no agent surface, or an explicit brush-off
Generic AI interest, a deck request, or pricing asked with no workflow named
Actively shipping or expanding a clinical agent, with reliability implied
Named failure mode, vendor review, security questionnaire, or an eval or coverage-gap question with a timeline

routing.name: immediate_outreach
routing.description: Strong ICP fit with a named decision-maker and a live or expanding agent. Send the evaluation gap assessment offer now.

routing.name: sequence_t1
routing.description: Good fit but the trigger is soft or the contact is a shared company inbox. Put into the standard first-touch sequence.

routing.name: nurture_pause
routing.description: Plausible fit with a real blocker right now: adjacent workflow, no agent evidence yet, or non-US go-to-market. Hold and revisit.

routing.name: disqualify
routing.description: Hospital or health system buyer, non-healthcare, hyperscaler, EHR incumbent, peer evaluation vendor, or no workable contact.

name: Enterprise DevOps Platform
icp_description: We sell a CI/CD and infrastructure observability platform to engineering organizations with more than 50 engineers. Buyers are VP Engineering, Head of Platform, or DevOps leads who own build pipelines and production reliability. We do not target agencies or single-developer teams.

criteria.name: Decision-maker access
criteria.description: The lead content identifies a contact with authority over engineering tooling, such as VP Engineering, Head of Platform, or a senior DevOps lead.

criteria.name: Technical pain point
criteria.description: The lead states a concrete problem with build speed, deployment reliability, or infrastructure visibility.

criteria.name: Team size sufficient
criteria.description: The lead states or clearly implies an engineering team of 50 or more people.

criteria.name: Existing tooling mentioned
criteria.description: The lead references current CI/CD, cloud, or observability tooling being used or replaced.

industry_levels: Irrelevant sector with no software engineering function
Adjacent sector with a small or outsourced engineering team
Core target: software, SaaS, or technology-driven engineering organization
maturity_levels: No funding or team information stated
Early-stage startup, seed to Series A
Growth-stage company, Series B or later
intent_levels: No stated need or evaluation activity
Passive interest, such as a newsletter signup or content download
Actively comparing vendors or requesting a demo
Stated budget and timeline to purchase

routing.name: immediate_sdr_outreach
routing.description: Strong ICP fit, decision-maker access, and active buying intent. Route to an SDR for immediate outreach.

routing.name: nurture_sequence
routing.description: Reasonable ICP fit but low urgency or no confirmed decision-maker. Add to a nurture email sequence.

routing.name: disqualify
routing.description: Poor ICP fit, wrong industry, or no evidence of a real business need. Disqualify the lead.

name: Mid-Market Fintech Compliance
icp_description: We sell automated transaction-monitoring and compliance software to banks, payment processors, and lending platforms with regulatory reporting obligations. Buyers are Heads of Compliance, Risk Officers, or General Counsel. We do not target unregulated retail or consumer apps.

criteria.name: Regulatory obligation
criteria.description: The lead content states a regulatory reporting, KYC, or AML obligation relevant to financial services.

criteria.name: Compliance buyer identified
criteria.description: The lead identifies a contact responsible for compliance, risk, or legal functions.

criteria.name: Manual process pain point
criteria.description: The lead describes a current manual, slow, or error-prone compliance process.

industry_levels: Non-financial business with no regulatory reporting need
Adjacent financial service with limited regulatory scope
Core target: bank, payment processor, or lending platform with direct regulatory obligations
maturity_levels: Established regulated institution with a dedicated compliance function
intent_levels: General awareness of upcoming regulatory change
Actively seeking a compliance vendor or facing an audit deadline

routing.name: immediate_sdr_outreach
routing.description: Confirmed regulatory obligation, right buyer, and near-term deadline. Route to an SDR for immediate outreach.

routing.name: nurture_sequence
routing.description: Fits the regulated profile but no urgent deadline stated. Add to a nurture sequence with compliance-deadline content.

routing.name: disqualify
routing.description: No regulatory obligation or the business is out of scope for financial compliance software. Disqualify the lead.
